text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER sev1 -> multi-region fallback triggered for /v1/generate. Hit threshold: 5xx spike + route failover. Paging oncall team. Details: errors=503, tail_latency+=120ms, affected regions: eu-west-1, eu-central-1. Pager: INC-4512
sara: oncall here, investigating. first check: kv-cache eviction patterns in eu-west. rolling kv evict spikes at 03:12 UTC.
mike: looking at router logs now, I see flood of req retries causing burst to fallback pools. correlating with autoscaler events.
neeraj: collecting traces and tail stacks, also checking model runner OOMs. attaching quick grep results: `grep -R "evict" /var/log/runner`
sara: mitigation path: 1) reroute eu traffic to us-east burst pool (non-blocking) 2) increase kv-cache ttl on eu nodes 3) temporarily disable aggressive batching for /v1/generate. Doing step 1 now.
product-ops: heads-up: we have 2 large customers in EU on paid SLAs. product tier shows ~9% error rate for them during spike. I'll open CS comms if it persists >30m.
mike: reroute applied via routing-policy v2 -> confirmed few seconds after change 503s on eu dropped by ~70%. Latency still elevated on tails.
sara: handoff: @mike taking live mitigation for network/routing, i'm owning cache and runner checks. oncall shift ends in 40m, will need formal handoff if still ongoing.
neeraj: found 1 runner with repeated GC/OOM logs around 03:10, suspect memory leak from new quantized model variant. Marking runner id r-12f4.
product-ops: customer-impact summary so far: ~12% error rate spike for EU region users for a 22m window, estimated 3k failed requests, potential SLA exposure for 2 customers.
(oncall): thanks team. stepping in for next hour to keep mitigation. please capture action items we want in the post-incident.
sara: agree, quick action items: - ACTION-1: root cause investigation for runner OOMs (owner: neeraj, size: 3d) - ACTION-2: routing-policy hardening to prevent cascade failover (owner: mike, size: 2d) - ACTION-3: kv-cache TTL/eviction tuning and canary rollout (owner: sara, size: 2d) - ACTION-4: customer comms draft + credits calc (owner: product-ops, size: 4h)
product-ops: noted. I'll draft comms and sync with CS. Recommend priority: ACTION-4 high (customer exposure), ACTION-1 high, ACTION-2 medium-high, ACTION-3 medium. Tie to Q2 reliability OKR for cache/route hardening.
mike: creating tickets: INC-4512 for live incident; followups: PM-789 (routing hardening), INF-224 (runner memory root cause), OPS-332 (cache tuning).
neeraj: initial hypothesis: regression in quantized model release 2026-03-09 causing memory bump under certain sequence patterns. Will reproduce locally.
sara: plan for postmortem: proposed slot tomorrow 10:00 UTC for 60m. Need eng-runtime, eng-oncall, eng-ml, product representation.
oncall: tomorrow 10:00 UTC works for rotation. Add remediation triage doc to agenda and estimate final owner for each action.
product-ops: please include cost/priority mapping in postmortem doc so we can slot into sprint vs. Q2 roadmap.
mike: quick sizes: PM-789 (routing) => 5 story points (2d dev + 1d testing), INF-224 (runner) => 8 points (3d debug + 3d fix + 1d deploy), OPS-332 (cache) => 3 points (2d canary + 1d rollback plan).
sara: filed postmortem stub: https://docs.internal/reports/INC-4512-postmortem (will populate). Assign owners in trackers once triage call finishes.
neeraj: I'll start bisecting model variant to confirm regression, target first reproducible case by EOD.
product-ops: CS comms: prepping a short note and credits calc, will hold until we have final impact number. Tentative send window after postmortem draft.
sara: closing live mitigation: routing fallback stable, tail latency still slowly decreasing. we'll keep monitoring overnight and reconvene at postmortem. Thanks for quick responses :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-4512 status update: mitigated -> partial (routing fallback active). Next: postmortem scheduled.
product-ops: postmortem invite sent to eng-runtime, eng-ml, eng-oncall, product, cs. Agenda: timeline, impact, RCA, action items + sizing + priority mapping, Q2 tie-ins.
action summary (for triage): [INC-4512-A1] INF-224 - runner memory RCA (owner: neeraj) - estimate: 3d, severity: P0; [INC-4512-A2] PM-789 - routing hardening (owner: mike) - estimate: 2d, severity: P1; [INC-4512-A3] OPS-332 - kv-cache tuning (owner: sara) - estimate: 2d, severity: P1; [INC-4512-A4] COMMS-12 - customer comms + credits calc (owner: product-ops) - estimate: 4h, severity: P0.
product-ops: will add priority tags in the tracker and propose which items need sales/security sign-off.
sara: thanks everyone. if you have more logs/traces drop them into INC-4512 thread in the tracker. We'll convert actions into sprint tickets in the triage meeting.
mike: noted. pulling together routing playbook snippets for PM-789.
neeraj: starting deeper debug now. ping me in thread if you need quick data.
product-ops: agreed on Q2 tie-in: route/cache hardening to be proposed for next Q2 reliability sprint; runner fix to be prioritized as immediate remediation.
(oncall): handing back to night rotation in 35m. Keep monitor alarms at default and escalate if errors >5% sustained.
sara: acknowledged. logging incident closed for live page at 03:42 UTC; postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
